definitions.explanation: Something limited to family members, close friends, or members of the same group. Often used to describe gatherings or matters not shared with outsiders.

examples.japanese: {内輪|うちわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{秘密|ひみつ}→秘密：02504_himitsu⟧にして⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: It's an insider conversation, so please keep it secret.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内輪|うちわ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We held the wedding among family and close friends only.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{内輪|うちわ}もめ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れている→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: An internal dispute within the company is causing the important project to fall behind.

notes:
Literally 'inside circle'. Refers to matters or gatherings confined to a particular in-group. Often appears as {内輪|うちわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内輪|うちわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: private conversation, insider talk
- {内輪|うちわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧: to celebrate among insiders
- {内輪|うちわ}もめ: internal dispute, infighting
- {内輪|うちわ}⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: humor that only insiders understand
- {内輪|うちわ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧: among ourselves only

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{団扇|うちわ}→団扇：04544_uchiwa⟧ (04544): a flat, non-folding paper fan — completely different word despite identical reading
